entries.title: The Watchful Caravan Guard

authored_character_exclusions: No named canonical NPCs, incompatible prior histories or overlapping major personal chains.
Never infer individual history from race, art or personality.

entries.core_promise: An aloof caravan guard must distinguish the hostile Orc warband that harmed a convoy from individual Orcs, with the player able to support vengeance, professional focus or earned reconciliation.

facets.claim: Speaks in short, deliberate observations; reserved is a voice habit, not evidence of indifference.
prerequisites: Assigned once at character creation; revelation follows a saved eligible beat.

facets.claim: Keeps conversational distance, especially when a person asks for trust before earning it.
prerequisites: Assigned once at character creation; revelation follows a saved eligible beat.

facets.claim: Previously helped guard a particular trade convoy and knows how to keep a moving group together.
prerequisites: Assigned once at character creation; revelation follows a saved eligible beat.
facets.provenance: Blueprint-specific latent autobiography supported by background:caravan_guard

facets.claim: A particular hostile Orc warband assaulted the convoy this individual guarded; loss of people and supplies remains unsettled, but no specific survivor or enemy identity is assumed.
prerequisites: Assigned once at character creation; revelation follows a saved eligible beat.

facets.claim: This individual is presently wary of Orcs because of that particular raid; the grievance does not establish that Orcs generally behave alike.
prerequisites: Assigned once at character creation; revelation follows a saved eligible beat.
facets.provenance: Individual starting belief, not a racial trait. Retire its active hostile dialogue if and only if transformed.

facets.claim: Wants to improve disciplined convoy protection rather than lose another vulnerable group to a rushed decision.
prerequisites: Assigned once at character creation; revelation follows a saved eligible beat.
facets.provenance: Professional motive anchored in the caravan-guard background.

facets.claim: After evidence and a voluntary turning point, evaluates an Orc player and other individuals on demonstrated choices rather than shared ancestry.
prerequisites: Active facet_distrust, a saved boundary_arm or boundary_private promise, verified costly truthful-report choice at node_quiet_account, and explicit reconciliation at milestone_reckoning. No Orc kills suffice.

facets.claim: Can commit to watching the player’s back as a chosen, loyal companion while remaining quiet and independent-minded.
prerequisites: Reconciliation resolved; explicit optional platonic pledge at node_trust.

remaining_reveal_beats.beat: Saved route-memory reveals prior convoy duty.
Saved watchcraft talk reveals desire to improve protection.
Only branch-verified truthful sacrifice and reconciliation transform distrust.
Only an accepted platonic pledge develops devotion.

establishment.established_when: Intro plus saved route-memory and watchcraft reveal the six fixed starting facets. Transformation and devotion remain optional.

reveal_beats: One-time prisoner talk reveals this individual’s preassigned caravan raid by a hostile Orc warband and resulting distrust; no race-wide guilt.
Only if approved and allocated, disclose proposed Orc-player loyalty ceiling 80 before recruitment or loyalty investment; separate from prison resistance.
Explain optional authenticated encounter and proposed truthful private-contract routes; the latter requires review, not an automatic spawn or payment.

prospective_loyalty_cap.when: Proposed only: player.race=Orc, this recruit has assigned grievance and active distrust, AND approved one-off allocation/recovery; never retroactive.
prospective_loyalty_cap.disclosed_before: First meaningful prisoner introduction, before recruitment confirmation or loyalty investment.
prospective_loyalty_cap.cause: Individual grievance against a particular hostile warband, not race-wide behavior or prison resistance.
prospective_loyalty_cap.lift_condition: Only an implemented, deterministic verified trust test followed by voluntary reconciliation can lift this specific cap; no loyalty points. Keep cap OFF until allocation, recovery, and trust path are approved and implemented.

player_options.consequence: Disclose conditional 80 cap before acceptance if approved and safely allocated; after recruitment unlock route-memory. No trust bonus.

player_options.player_intent: Ask what happened, without demanding trust.
player_options.consequence: Disclose only seeded history; after recruitment unlock route-memory.
Defer recruitment without cap or committed reward. Same introduction resumes; final decline and reservation disposition need approved policy.

choices.consequence: Save background reveal.
Pause at this node.

choices.consequence: Save character_blueprints_pilot_001.guard_01.state_truthful_promise and arm same one-off arc; no enemy spawned.

choices.player_intent: Pursue an ordinary private-contract review instead.
choices.consequence: Save same truthful promise and arm deterministic quiet route.
Unarmed, return here later.
Confirm this character’s stop without reward. How the player-scoped slot is released or consumed remains an approval-blocking policy choice; never strand a capped recruit.

conversation_nodes.when: After a verified encounter outcome; conscious guard at camp.
conversation_nodes.speaker_intent: Requests an accurate account, including ally credit and final capture status.

choices.consequence: Store report and exact outcome; truthful recital alone does NOT prove costly trust.
Hold the same recorded outcome.

conversation_nodes.when: Once the reconciliation branch is saved, offered once after resolution.
conversation_nodes.speaker_intent: Affirms changed belief while retaining quiet demeanor.

reveal_or_develop.transition: Activate on saved reconciliation, retire active distrust.

choices.consequence: Develop devotion once; no romance, loyalty points or AI bonus.
Reconciliation stands; no devotion.

conversation_nodes.when: Proposed only: after saved boundary_arm or boundary_private, including reckoning recovery if the original offer is pending and unconsumed; same instance, no reroll.
conversation_nodes.speaker_intent: Reviews seeded convoy facts and a proposed disputed compensation claim wrongly blaming unrelated Orcs; a real claim and payer would require approval.

choices.player_intent: Sign the accurate limited report and waive the optional disputed compensation.
choices.consequence: If approved and genuinely available, irrevocably waive real compensation and record fair attribution as state_costly_truthful_report; return to the saved reckoning.
Irrevocably take the offered claim, record state_disputed_claim_taken; no costly-truth proof and no reset on reload. Return to reckoning.
Leave this same offer pending; resume quiet account later, then return to reckoning after a committed choice.
Confirm final stop without proof or payout; no retroactive cap can be left unresolved by an unapproved allocation policy.

personal_arcs.armed_by: Saved boundary_arm or boundary_private; one player-scoped instance with the original repeat key; entitlement and later-recruit handling require approval.

entry_conditions.review_only_context: Recruited, grievance-seeded guard with saved promise and approved deterministic trust fallback. Optional combat binds an existing hostile Orc to the same warband BEFORE encounter; never relabel generic enemies or spawn a mandatory foe.

participants: Individual recruited guard; player with reviewed player.race context.
Combat option: already-existing visible hostile Orc with saved pre-encounter warband affiliation; ordinary allies may land final hit.
Quiet option: player and guard reviewing seeded facts and an authentic, optional disputed claim ONLY if its source and cost are approved.

prerequisites: Saved boundary_arm, guard recruited.
milestones.player_objective: Accept evidence-based accountability without a required personal kill.
milestones.scoring: Save consent once; the proposed private offer may be reached without an enemy, if approved.

prerequisites: Consent saved; reviewed generation hook has bound a compatible existing hostile BEFORE mission; it is visible.
milestones.player_objective: Recognize affiliation only after seeing the bound foe.
milestones.scoring: Recognize only validated affiliation; if absent, route to the pending quiet account if approved, not random encounters.

prerequisites: Same saved enemy, actual combat result recorded.
milestones.player_objective: Allow real defeat, lawful finalized alive capture, escape or restraint; avoid mandatory guard final hit.
milestones.scoring: Track ally final hit, death, defeat, escape, retreat and actual finalized capture distinctly; actor-down delays talk. Pending outcome waits, not victory.

prerequisites: A conscious guard; documented encounter report OR saved quiet-contract decision.
milestones.player_objective: Choose verified specialism, evidenced reconciliation, explicit quiet-account recovery, deferral or warned final stop.
milestones.scoring: Specialism needs documented affiliated combat; reconciliation requires state_costly_truthful_report and consent, not Orc defeat. If proof is missing and the same quiet offer is unconsumed, route there on request; after a committed choice return here. If absent or spent, block reconciliation and permit other valid endings; no second payout.

resolution_branches.name: Warband accountability and specialization
resolution_branches.trigger: Authenticated same-warband encounter, factual report and explicit specialization choice.
resolution_branches.resolved: This encounter is addressed; training is chosen.
resolution_branches.remaining_conflicts: Orc distrust and Orc-player 80 cap remain; no implied trust.
resolution_branches.facet_changes: Retain facet_mastery and facet_distrust; no individuals-first conversion or devotion.
resolution_branches.base_personality_change: No base personality or combat-AI change.

resolution_branches.name: Truthful reconciliation and optional platonic bond
resolution_branches.trigger: Prior boundary_arm or boundary_private promise; node_quiet_account.quiet_publish has irreversibly waived a real offered disputed payment and logged fair attribution; guard freely affirms at reckoning.
resolution_branches.resolved: Collective distrust ends and this player is assessed individually; grievance history is not erased.
resolution_branches.remaining_conflicts: Specific warband losses may remain unredressed; no automatic relationship score or devotion.
resolution_branches.facet_changes: Deactivate facet_distrust; activate facet_individuals; optional later facet_devotion at node_trust. Lift only conditional Orc-player cap.
resolution_branches.base_personality_change: No base personality or combat-AI change.

resolution_branches.name: Final stop without fabricated resolution
resolution_branches.trigger: Explicit final stop at boundary_decline, quiet_stop, or reckoning; show remaining distrust first.
resolution_branches.resolved: The hunt ends without pretending proof or trust.
resolution_branches.remaining_conflicts: Distrust remains; an Orc-player cap persists ONLY if an approved safe allocation ever enabled it. No substitute chain or reward.
resolution_branches.facet_changes: Keep fixed facts, distrust and normal professional dialogue; no devotion.
resolution_branches.base_personality_change: No base personality or combat-AI change.

failure_and_recovery: No valid bound foe, target dead/escaped, or encounter blocked: use only the existing unconsumed proposed quiet-account route, if approved; never spawn or revive an enemy.
An ally final hit is credited accurately; downed guard waits for recovery, retreat holds the same attempt. Capture counts only when existing capture/recovery finalizes alive custody, not on HP loss.

At reckoning with insufficient trust proof, offer an explicit same-instance return to node_quiet_account if unconsumed; its publish/claim choices return here, wait resumes there, stop closes uncertainty.

Taking the claim irreversibly forecloses this proof; no reroll, second payment or substitute arc. If private contract is unapproved/unavailable, disable the Orc-player cap. Defer resumes; confirmed stop closes.
Player-scoped reservation/consumption on dismissal, later recruits, final decline and successful completion remains undecided. Do not assign a cap until safety policy and recovery exist.

conclusion.established_condition: Intro plus two saved ordinary talks; not conditional on an encounter.
conclusion.core_closed_condition: One saved specialization, reconciliation or warned final-stop branch. A defer is not closure.
conclusion.closed_behavior: No new major personal warband chain or replayable reward; retire resolved hunt prompts, not history.
conclusion.continuing_growth: Reserved conversation, friendships, normal progression and memories continue; devotion is optional and platonic.

reward_contracts.player_expectation: A useful lasting way to fight the confirmed warband threat.
reward_contracts.setup: Before acceptance, choose a REVIEWED permanent option: enemy-type anti-Orc damage technique/perk, or a defensive anti-Orc formation method.
reward_contracts.narrative_payoff: Practical expertise rather than miscellaneous spoils.

grant_proposal.description: Propose ONE nonstacking, once-only anti-Orc damage perk/technique (enemy-type scoped); defensive protection training is a mutually exclusive alternative. Numbers/ID unapproved.

reward_contracts.why_it_fits: Offense rewards specialization against eligible Orc enemies; defense offers wider team protection but less direct damage.
reward_contracts.alternative_branch_fairness: No substitution with supplies after a permanent technique is promised. Different ending may offer truthful closure instead.

reward_contracts.player_expectation: Recognition of a meaningful costly choice and freedom from blanket suspicion.
reward_contracts.setup: Proposed trust test: actual waiver of a documented, optional disputed claim, if approved; otherwise another grounded test needs separate design approval.
reward_contracts.narrative_payoff: Explicit trust, a witnessed corrected account and optional platonic promise.

grant_proposal.description: Propose persistent belief conversion and remembered trust; lift Orc-player 80 ceiling if active, with NO loyalty-point award or hidden bond stat.

reward_contracts.why_it_fits: Non-Orc players get the same acknowledged trust and altered future dialogue even without a cap to lift.
reward_contracts.alternative_branch_fairness: Unlike the combat-perk branch this pays off in lasting narrative relationship and belief change; present tradeoff before commitment.

reward_contracts.player_expectation: An honest ability to stop involvement.
reward_contracts.setup: Warn that distrust and the conditional cap survive.
reward_contracts.narrative_payoff: A chosen boundary without invented revenge or absolution.

grant_proposal.description: No reward, no cap removal, no perk; preserve ordinary growth.

reward_contracts.why_it_fits: The player may decline optional content without losing existing gear.
reward_contracts.alternative_branch_fairness: Not advertised as equivalent to completing the personal arc.

remembered_facts: Seeded caravan raid; selected path; bound encounter outcome when applicable; whether disputed compensation was truly waived; one-off reward claim.
Active distrust versus resolved individuals-first belief; conditional cap state; separate optional platonic pledge.
retired_hostile_lines: On reconciliation, retire broad anti-Orc suspicion and unresolved-hunt triggers; retain factual grief and justified criticism of actual attackers.
new_voice_beats: Specialist: understated planning pride without reconciliation.
Reconciled: specific gratitude for the costly truthful report; reserved style remains.
Unresolved stop: normal guard talk without repeated offers.
aftermath.personality_change_scope: Strategist stays strategist; no combat-AI changes.
aftermath.relationship_change_scope: Earned trust is remembered; optional devotion needs explicit separate player consent, never romance by default.

capability_requests.description: Persist individualized convoy grievance and pre-encounter provenance; optionally assign compatible existing unnamed procedural warband enemy within normal mission budget.

Read player.race and disclose a proposed 80 cap before recruitment; safely allocate player one-off before cap-bearing history OR approve nonreward later-recruit resolution. capability_requests.description: Balance exclusive permanent anti-Orc damage versus defensive training; approve implementation and reward before promise is displayed.
Persist actual ally final hit, actor recovery, retreat, enemy death/escape and finalized capture.
capability_requests.reason: Facts must be verified; no resurrection or automatic capture.

entries.title: The Workshop Ledger

authored_character_exclusions: No named canonical NPCs, incompatible prior histories or overlapping major personal chains.
Never infer individual history from race, art or personality.

entries.core_promise: A sociable but exacting engineer learns that professional integrity requires recording mistakes and accepting help, not silently carrying every repair alone.

facets.claim: Has practiced ordinary repair and inspection work before joining the party.
prerequisites: Assigned once at character creation; revelation follows a saved eligible beat.

facets.claim: Takes genuine pride in careful work, especially plain things that do not break.
prerequisites: Assigned once at character creation; revelation follows a saved eligible beat.
facets.provenance: Professional voice rooted in artisan and engineer experience.

facets.claim: Finds it easy to chat about tools and other people’s work, though not their own mistake.
prerequisites: Assigned once at character creation; revelation follows a saved eligible beat.
facets.provenance: Contrasts with blueprint 1 without treating dutiful as automatically outgoing.

facets.claim: Wants a dependable, repeatable way to check work rather than relying on a lucky successful repair.
prerequisites: Assigned once at character creation; revelation follows a saved eligible beat.
facets.provenance: Ordinary professional ambition, not an unlock promise.

facets.claim: In one earlier job, this person signed off a faulty count, wasted materials and avoided telling anyone it was their mistake.
prerequisites: One approved per-character unreported-quality-error fact exists before node_admission; tag stays null until registered.
facets.provenance: Not supported by current history tags

facets.claim: Wants to make good on the wasted resources by sharing a reliable check method with somebody else.
prerequisites: Assigned once at character creation; revelation follows a saved eligible beat.
facets.provenance: Individual motive tied to the exact past mistake, not a generic guilt mechanic.

facets.claim: Becomes willing to let another person inspect work and correct an error without feeling personally erased.
prerequisites: Committed paired preparation check, eligible mission success, conscious debrief and accepted truthful ledger choice.
facets.provenance: Development from friendly talk to professional trust

facets.claim: Begins to value shared responsibility in the party as much as being the one who can fix everything.
prerequisites: Committed paired preparation check, eligible mission success, conscious debrief and accepted truthful ledger choice.
facets.provenance: Open development, not a retroactive change to employment, race or base personality.

preparation_choice.effect: Commit the narrative two-person check and accepted correction as a saved fact. No equipment change, physical minigame or reward.

Actor down can debrief only after recovery.

resolution_branches.base_personality_change: No base personality or combat-AI change.

resolution_branches.resolved: Honest private responsibility and shared method without invented outside audience.

resolution_branches.base_personality_change: No base personality or combat-AI change.

failure_and_recovery: Absent or unconscious partner at preparation: withhold prepare_joint_check until another eligible ordinary mission.
After check, actor down delays talk until recovery. Failure/retreat preserves the committed check; retry ordinary participation until the first eligible mission SUCCESS, never recheck.
Capture or defeat is irrelevant to inspection; ally final hit counts only through verified team success. No special enemy or revival.
Defer preserves state, confirmed stop closes this optional chain, and reloads or alternate choices cannot duplicate the reward.

conclusion.established_condition: Intro and seeded admission reveal normal identity independently of quest.
conclusion.core_closed_condition: Explicit shared, private or final-stop resolution; mission entry and agreement alone do not close the arc.

decision_points.question: Keep the specific disputed-compensation waiver as the guard’s costly trust proof, or replace it with a grounded nonfinancial test?
decision_points.recommendation: Favor a grounded nonfinancial test if a real entitled claim cannot be sourced. The financial test gives measurable sacrifice but needs credible payer, entitlement, amount, genuine cost and irreversible accounting; neither is approved.
alternatives: Keep compensation waiver as an UNAPPROVED proposal, pending proof of legitimate source, terms, opportunity cost and deterministic same-instance recovery.
Replace with a specific, grounded nonfinancial truthful-risk test to be designed and reviewed separately; do not finalize an alternate plot or cost here.

decision_points.question: How may a character receive a grievance-based loyalty cap when its resolving personal arc runs only once per player?
decision_points.recommendation: Prefer reserving the player one-off before assigning the cap-bearing history; this avoids stranded later recruits but limits who receives that history. A nonreward later-recruit resolution offers broader variety but adds a separately designed route.
alternatives: Reserve the single player-scoped resolving arc before assigning cap-bearing grievance/distrust; define release/consumption for deferral, dismissal, final decline, success and later recruitment.
Allow later cap-bearing recruits only with a distinct, deterministic, NONREWARD trust resolution, no repeat key or second payout; design and approve its routing first.
